page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 224.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server is equipped with two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units, providing a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and dual NVIDIA P4 GPUs, this instance is designed for workloads requiring parallel processing capabilities alongside substantial compute resources. The hardware configuration is suitable for GPU-accelerated tasks such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, and parallel computing workloads. The absence of local storage represents a structural tradeoff, requiring external storage provisioning.
